title: Spend History Weighed for Goodwill on Spent-Credit Charges
content:
When spent Return Store Credit from a Returns & Exchanges Store Credit Return is charged to the original card, the cardholder's spend history is weighed for goodwill. The spend history is measured from the cardholder's Marlowe Rewards points ledger, in a way set by the Marlowe Rewards membership in status active.

## How the spend history is measured

| Marlowe Rewards membership in status active | Measure | Spend history |
|---|---|---|
| Platinum, Icon or Atelier | Better membership year | The larger of: the qualifying spend of its earning postings in the last 12 calendar months, and the qualifying spend of its earning postings in the 12 calendar months before them |
| Gold | Gross spend | The qualifying spend of its earning postings in the last 12 calendar months |
| Anyone else (Member or Silver, or no active membership) | Kept spend | The qualifying spend of its earning postings in the last 12 calendar months, less the spend reversed by its points reversals posted in the same 12 months |

- "Earning postings" are the ledger's points-earned postings; their qualifying spend is the spend recorded on them.
- "Spend reversed" is the reversed spend recorded on the ledger's points-reversal postings.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

A ledger shows qualifying spend of 1400.00 on earning postings in the last 12 calendar months and 2100.00 in the 12 months before them, with 300.00 of spend reversed in the last 12 months.

| Tier | Spend history |
|---|---|
| Platinum | The larger of 1400.00 and 2100.00: 2100.00 |
| Gold | 1400.00 |
| Silver | 1400.00 less 300.00: 1100.00 |
